items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: In the old days, Scott Joplin used to bring many of

ctx.x: My mother was born in Denison, Texas. My father was born in Sherman, Texas. My father was the leader of a orchestra. As a matter of fact, he was the leader of the first jazz band that ever came out of North Texas. It was the Marshal Royal Band. He played in the World's Fair in St. Louis, I believe, somewhere around 1892 or somewhere around that era and he was also in San Francisco during the big earthquake with his band. He was one of the first guys that had a band of that type that was considered as being a…

his scores down to let my father's orchestra try them out for him and try to put them together because my dad was a music teacher and my uncle was in his band, was also a music teacher and a very accomplished musician.
